# Auto Sign

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Auto Sign, AutoSign

## What it does

Automatically writes signs. The first sign's text will be used.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/world/AutoSign.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

### [Wurst — AutoSign](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/AutoSignHack.java)
